snippet.title: Wolcen 2 - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Many years after Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem, return to a world on the brink of collapse. Master brutal combat, build your character without fixed classes, combine skills and gear, and unleash your Shadow Form in this dark fantasy Action RPG. Play alone or in co-op.

Wishlist Wolcen 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216080/Wolcen_2

Playtest starts now! Sign up for it: https://contributors.wolcenstudio.com/

Join Discord and be part of the discussion: https://discord.gg/wolcenstudio

Follow Wolcen 2 on socials: https://linktr.ee/playwolcen
